name: @ai-games/vending-machine
description: Fizzwick's Tonic-O-Matic: a three.js retro power-up soda machine. Everything is generated in code (extruded/lathed geometry, canvas-painted textures seeded from @ai-games/schema's PRNG, WebAudio-synthesised sound) — no binary assets. Four flavours re-livery the machine; vending plays a coin/rumble/drop/drink sequence and awards a perk.
